winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一

clip_research.source_claim: Market-implied probability of a Fed hike is about 90%, but Monica Hsiao puts it at 65-70% and says a hike is not a foregone conclusion.
clip_research.public_baseline: CME FedWatch and Fed funds futures were reported around 90% for a hike at the September meeting after a hot core CPI print.
clip_research.surprise_gap: The speaker explicitly rejects the market-implied 90% consensus and substitutes a materially lower 65-70% estimate, framing the gap as consequential for forward projections.

evidence.fact: Speaker says 90% probability is 'in my opinion' too high and pins her own estimate at 65-70%.

evidence.query: Fed fund futures probability September rate hike 90%
evidence.fact: Markets were pricing about a 90% chance of a hike at the Wednesday Fed meeting, per CME FedWatch.

forbidden_claims: Do not claim the speaker predicted the Fed would not hike.
Do not claim the 90% figure was wrong or that markets mispriced the meeting.
Do not attribute the 90% figure to the speaker as her own view.

clip_research.source_claim: 100 basis points of cumulative hikes priced through next year is overdone; the speaker sees roughly one or two hikes this year and is cautious on duration.

evidence.fact: Speaker says 100bps priced cumulatively through next year is 'definitely overdone' and sees one or two hikes this year.

forbidden_claims: Do not claim the speaker forecast rate cuts.
Do not claim she said the Fed will definitely hike only once.

clip_research.source_claim: With a long-end anchor, the 10-year Treasury yield is unlikely to break 5%; Treasury buybacks and healthy auction demand support the long end, while credit spreads drift slowly wider.
clip_research.public_baseline: The 10-year Treasury yield touched 5% on September 14, 2026, its first time at that level since 2023, on inflation and supply concerns.
clip_research.surprise_gap: The speaker's 'unlikely to break 5%' framing sits against a market where the 10-year yield had just touched 5%, making the call a direct counter to the prevailing move.

evidence.fact: Speaker cites healthy 10-year auction demand and Treasury buybacks of about $5.19bn against a $6bn cap.

evidence.query: Monica Shell Triata Capital 10-year Treasury yield 5%
evidence.fact: The 10-year Treasury yield reached a multiyear high and touched 5% ahead of the Fed decision.

forbidden_claims: Do not claim the speaker said the 10-year yield will fall.
Do not claim she predicted a specific yield level below 5%.
Do not claim the buyback program was larger than announced.

clip_research.source_claim: The three major AI labs have not committed to a broad AI pause; they are talking about mechanisms to pace the frontier and do more safety work before releasing models.
clip_research.public_baseline: The 'Pacing the Frontier' letter, signed by over 1,000 employees at OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind and Meta, asks the US government to support tools to deliberately pace frontier AI development.
clip_research.surprise_gap: Public coverage frames the letter as a slowdown request, while the speaker insists it is not a pause commitment, correcting a common misreading.

evidence.fact: Speaker says the labs 'haven't said that they are committing now to a broad AI pause' and are discussing mechanisms to pace the frontier.

evidence.query: Micah Hill Smith AI pause commitment mechanisms pace frontier
evidence.fact: The Pacing the Frontier letter requests US government support for technical and governance tools to deliberately pace frontier AI development.

forbidden_claims: Do not claim the labs committed to pausing AI development.
Do not claim the speaker said the labs will stop releasing models.
Do not claim the letter was signed by the companies themselves rather than employees.

clip_research.source_claim: The top US labs' commitment to pace the frontier is significant and other industry players are expected to follow, but it is not a commitment to stop progress or stop releasing models.
clip_research.public_baseline: The Pacing the Frontier letter drew signatures from employees at OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind and Meta, and Anthropic's Dario Amodei publicly recommended a three-step plan to pace the frontier.
clip_research.surprise_gap: The speaker expects broader industry follow-on, which goes beyond what the letter itself commits signatories to do.

evidence.fact: Speaker says 'it is significant that all of the leading American players just this weekend have made this commitment' and expects other players to follow.

evidence.query: Micah Hill Smith AI pause commitment mechanisms pace frontier
evidence.fact: Amodei recommended a three-step plan for leading AI companies to 'pace the frontier'.

forbidden_claims: Do not claim the labs agreed to a binding slowdown.
Do not claim Chinese labs have signed the same commitment.
Do not claim the speaker speaks for the labs.

clip_research.source_claim: Many leading Chinese AI labs are more aggressive than US labs about releasing open-weight models, producing the strongest open-weight models, and their speed culture is ingrained; open weights cannot be recalled, changing the risk profile.

china_advantage.comparison: Chinese labs are described as more aggressive than leading US labs in releasing open-weight models, with the strongest open-weight models coming from Chinese labs.

evidence.fact: Speaker says many leading Chinese AI labs are 'much more aggressive about giving away open weights copies of their models than the leading American labs', leading to the strongest open-weight models coming from Chinese labs.
Speaker notes Chinese labs' speed culture is 'ingrained in the DNA' and that open-weight releases cannot be taken back.

forbidden_claims: Do not claim Chinese labs have the smartest model overall.
Do not claim the speaker said Chinese labs will overtake US labs.
Do not claim open-weight releases are irreversible in a legal sense.

clip_research.source_claim: The market is digesting AI safety fears around frontier models and liability questions, and is trying to look past them to the longer-term AI capex outlook.

evidence.fact: Speaker says the market is 'just digesting these fears and then trying to look past what the longer term outlook for AI cap X is'.

forbidden_claims: Do not claim the speaker said AI capex will be cut.
Do not claim the speaker said Anthropic has already gone public.

clip_research.source_claim: Chinese AI labs face a profitability problem, are burning free cash flow, and DeepSeek's price cuts add pressure; they must stay fast on model development and find a path to profitability.

china_advantage.comparison: Chinese labs are credited with catching up to the middle layer of the Pareto frontier in model development, even as they face profitability pressure.

evidence.fact: Speaker says Chinese labs 'have done a great job with their model development by catching up' to the middle layer of the Pareto frontier.
Speaker says none of the Chinese AI labs make profits and they are burning free cash flow, with DeepSeek's price cuts adding pressure.

forbidden_claims: Do not claim Chinese AI labs are unprofitable as a permanent condition.
Do not claim DeepSeek's price cuts were the sole cause of industry pressure.
Do not claim the speaker said Chinese labs will fail.

Each candidate must make a viewer feel one strong reaction instead of mild interest. Use the research guide as a hard boundary: unsupported surprise, dishonesty, holdings, public actions, and national comparisons are forbidden. Wording guard for all Chinese output:
- Do not use hard crisis/doom financial wording such as 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、流动性危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了、萧条、衰退.
- Prefer neutral market-language alternatives: 流动性变化、信贷变化、债务压力、政策信号、需求变化、信心修复、估值重估、周期压力、结构调整、市场波动、边际变化.
- For China-related clips, do not frame China, Chinese companies, Chinese assets, Chinese consumers, or Chinese policy as hopeless, collapsing, being mocked, or fundamentally bad.
- If the source is negative about China-related macro/markets, keep the fact but soften the Chinese wording: talk about pressure, policy response, demand repair, liquidity change, confidence repair, valuation reset, or structural adjustment.
- Never directly use 房价/房價/住房价格/住宅价格/房屋价格/楼市价格 in Chinese output. Preserve the source direction, number, and unit, but paraphrase by context: use 地产市场上行/调整/趋稳/修复 for direction, 居住成本/住房可负担性/置业负担 for affordability, 地产估值 for valuation, and 住宅成交水平 for absolute levels. Do not evade this rule with another blunt housing-price synonym.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

Title and display rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Use exactly three non-empty title lines, each a punchy cover block. Ideal lengths: 3-10, 4-12, 5-14 Chinese characters.
- Full title should be short and sharp, ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- Keep only one core conflict. Do not pack background, claim, caveat, and conclusion into one line.
- Highlights must be exact substrings of joined title_lines and emphasize the actor, number, reversal, China advantage, or tension.
- Do not use flat endings such as 回报路径在哪、回报存疑、前景如何、未来如何、有待观察、仍不明朗、面临挑战、带来机遇、释放信号、关键分叉在哪、有望扩大. Turn the caveat into a concrete unresolved action or contradiction.
- Every line must be a complete Chinese phrase. Do not leave a transitive tension verb such as 逼急、逼到、迫使 or 倒逼 without its subject or object.
- Do not use source badges, emojis, markdown, quotation marks, hashtags, or numbering.
- Title fields must not contain 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

Title and display rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Use exactly three non-empty title lines, each a punchy cover block. Ideal lengths: 3-10, 4-12, 5-14 Chinese characters.
- Full title should be short and sharp, ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- Keep only one core conflict. Do not pack background, claim, caveat, and conclusion into one line.
- Highlights must be exact substrings of joined title_lines and emphasize the actor, number, reversal, China advantage, or tension.
- Do not use flat endings such as 回报路径在哪、回报存疑、前景如何、未来如何、有待观察、仍不明朗、面临挑战、带来机遇、释放信号、关键分叉在哪、有望扩大. Turn the caveat into a concrete unresolved action or contradiction.
- Every line must be a complete Chinese phrase. Do not leave a transitive tension verb such as 逼急、逼到、迫使 or 倒逼 without its subject or object.
- Do not use source badges, emojis, markdown, quotation marks, hashtags, or numbering.
- Title fields must not contain 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出.
- Never use 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了.
- Do not mention sensitive geopolitical or military topics.

KC comment rules:
- comment starts with KC评论： and adds context, consequence, or the next fact to watch in 16-34 Chinese characters. Do not repeat the title.
- subtitle_comments contains one item for every input subtitle index, grounded in that exact subtitle rather than a generic clip slogan.
- Each subtitle comment starts with KC评论： and is ideally 10-24 Chinese characters after the prefix, with a complete ending.
- Adjacent subtitle comments must vary between evidence, implication, tension, consequence, and context.
- All highlight strings must be exact substrings of their corresponding title/comment.

6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

Title and display rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Use exactly three non-empty title lines, each a punchy cover block. Ideal lengths: 3-10, 4-12, 5-14 Chinese characters.
- Full title should be short and sharp, ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- Keep only one core conflict. Do not pack background, claim, caveat, and conclusion into one line.
- Highlights must be exact substrings of joined title_lines and emphasize the actor, number, reversal, China advantage, or tension.
- Do not use flat endings such as 回报路径在哪、回报存疑、前景如何、未来如何、有待观察、仍不明朗、面临挑战、带来机遇、释放信号、关键分叉在哪、有望扩大. Turn the caveat into a concrete unresolved action or contradiction.
- Every line must be a complete Chinese phrase. Do not leave a transitive tension verb such as 逼急、逼到、迫使 or 倒逼 without its subject or object.
- Do not use source badges, emojis, markdown, quotation marks, hashtags, or numbering.
- Title fields must not contain 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出.
- Never use 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了.

- Adjacent subtitle comments must vary between evidence, implication, tension, consequence, and context.
- All highlight strings must be exact substrings of their corresponding title/comment.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

Title and display rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Use exactly three non-empty title lines, each a punchy cover block. Ideal lengths: 3-10, 4-12, 5-14 Chinese characters.
- Full title should be short and sharp, ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- Keep only one core conflict. Do not pack background, claim, caveat, and conclusion into one line.
- Highlights must be exact substrings of joined title_lines and emphasize the actor, number, reversal, China advantage, or tension.
- Do not use flat endings such as 回报路径在哪、回报存疑、前景如何、未来如何、有待观察、仍不明朗、面临挑战、带来机遇、释放信号、关键分叉在哪、有望扩大. Turn the caveat into a concrete unresolved action or contradiction.
- Every line must be a complete Chinese phrase. Do not leave a transitive tension verb such as 逼急、逼到、迫使 or 倒逼 without its subject or object.
- Do not use source badges, emojis, markdown, quotation marks, hashtags, or numbering.
- Title fields must not contain 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出.
- Never use 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了.
- Do not mention sensitive geopolitical or military topics.

KC comment rules:
- comment starts with KC评论： and adds context, consequence, or the next fact to watch in 16-34 Chinese characters. Do not repeat the title.
- subtitle_comments contains one item for every input subtitle index, grounded in that exact subtitle rather than a generic clip slogan.
- Each subtitle comment starts with KC评论： and is ideally 10-24 Chinese characters after the prefix, with a complete ending.
- Adjacent subtitle comments must vary between evidence, implication, tension, consequence, and context.
- All highlight strings must be exact substrings of their corresponding title/comment.

briefs.current_title: Triata Capital Monica Shell：美联储加息概率90%？市场预期或过于激进

subtitles.zh: 美联储本周即将召开会议，市场几乎认定加息已成定局。根据联邦基金期货或互换合约，概率约为90%，信哪个由你选。
subtitles.en: Fed's coming up this week and as far as markets go it's almost a foregone conclusion that they're going to hike interest rate. Let's call it 90% probability based on Fed fund futures or swaps, pick your poison here

subtitles.zh: 他们将会加息。本周我们来了解一下市场是否真的消化了这一点。精准解读这一信号的是 Monica Shell，她是 Triata Capital 的创始人兼首席信息官。
subtitles.en: that they are going to hike interest rates. This week let's get a sense of whether or not markets are getting this one. The telemetry on this one accurately Monica Shell is with us founder and CIO

subtitles.zh: Triata Capital。你如何看待这些概率？我认为，在数据公布后，他们更有可能加息，但我不认为这是板上钉钉的事。所以在我看来，90%的概率有点高了。
subtitles.en: Triata Capital. So what do you make of these odds? So I think that now after the data I think it's more likely than not that they would hike but I don't think it's a foregone conclusion. So 90% probability in my opinion is a bit high.

subtitles.zh: 如果你非要我给出一个数字，我会说大概在65%到70%之间。也许这个细微差别对一些人来说不重要，但实际上我认为它关系到我们对前瞻性预测的理解。
subtitles.en: I probably if you force me to pin a number I would say it's like 65 to 70 percent and maybe this nuance doesn't matter to people but actually I think it matters as to our concept of the forward projections.

subtitles.zh: 你认为动机在某种程度上也是为了恢复一些公信力，而不仅仅是稳定物价之类的吗？我认为鉴于沃什在杰克逊霍尔的讲话，公信力确实值得一谈。
subtitles.en: Do you think the motivation is in some ways to restore some credibility as well beyond just the whole stabilization of prices and the like? I think given Worsh's talk at Jackson Hole there is something to be said about credibility

subtitles.zh: 但特别是因为市场的定价方式，我关注的不仅仅是前端90%的概率，更重要的是，如果他们不加息，对长端会有什么后果。
subtitles.en: but in particular because of the way that market has priced it and what I'm looking at is not just the 90% probability in the front end but more so you know what are the consequences if they don't hike to the long end
